title: Magnitude order: Positive proof strip
summary: Sort readings by absolute value ascending, breaking ties by numeric value ascending. Keep duplicate readings. Return only the strictly positive values in the derived sequence, preserving their relative order and duplicates.
descriptionMd:
A technician sorts signed gauge errors by how far they lie from the center mark. Mina prepares a clean proof strip for the front desk. Positive derived readings keep their places relative to one another.

Sort readings by absolute value ascending, breaking ties by numeric value ascending. Keep duplicate readings.

Return only the strictly positive values in the derived sequence, preserving their relative order and duplicates.

Implement magnitudeOrderPositiveProofStrip(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.

Target time O(n log n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.

referenceSolutions.python:
def magnitudeOrderPositiveProofStrip(readings, k):
    a=readings
    out=[]
    out=sorted(a,key=lambda x:(abs(x),x))
    return [x for x in out if x>0]
